item.title: From Lost Girl to Advocate: Rebecca Deng on Surviving War, Displacement, and Gender-Based Violence
item.description: In this episode of Conversations on Genocide , Brenda and Bhaswati speak with Rebecca Deng, a South Sudanese American author and human rights advocate who survived war, displacement, and gender-based violence as one of the 89 Lost Girls of Sudan.
